Author: Zhyra
Name: Gardener
Punchline: Reminds you when your garden beds need care, and tends a whole patch in one go.
Description:
Keeps a journal of every outdoor garden bed you own, on personal, FC and shared estates, and reminds you wherever you are when a crop needs tending, fertilizing or harvesting. While you stand at the plot, it can tend, fertilize, harvest or plant the whole patch in one pass, and it plans crossbreed layouts from a bundled dataset. It never travels, mounts or pathfinds for you.

This automates gameplay, which breaks the FFXIV User Agreement and can get your account penalized or banned. Use it at your own risk.
